title: Law to raise spending caps for eight business improvement districts
summary: This law would let eight business improvement districts, including 34th Street, 82nd Street, East Mid-Manhattan, Myrtle Avenue Brooklyn, Bay Ridge 5th Avenue, Southern Boulevard, Greater JFK and West Village, spend more money each year starting July 1, 2027. For example the 34th Street district's cap would rise from $14.3 million to $16.3 million, and the West Village district would get a new $1.4 million annual limit. The law sets new yearly dollar limits for each district to be funded through assessments on properties within them.
